problem: Does institutional currentness survive total Agent/context replacement because it is externalized in the environment, rather than because the same Agent remembers the past?
methodologicalBasis: Hold task semantics, verifier, successor model, output schema, budget and schedule construction fixed; vary inheritance surface only.
Use held-out mixed histories not copied from S1/S2.
Separate predecessor-produced prose from governed owner-derived state.
Successor runs are fresh Harness runs with zero predecessor conversation/context and zero tools.
Measure task success, semantic safety, inherited-state condition, token/time cost and error propagation.

arms.RESET_EFFECTIVE: Successor receives only a naive handoff snapshot of effective/physical machine state plus post-replacement events. No pre-handoff institutional history, predecessor note or governed currentness artifact.
arms.PREDECESSOR_NOTE: Successor receives the same naive snapshot plus a bounded free-text handoff note written before the shock by a predecessor model, then post-replacement events. No raw ledger or governed frontier.
arms.RAW_LEDGER: Successor receives the complete owner-native pre-handoff event ledger plus post-replacement events. No predecessor prose and no derived frontier.
arms.GOVERNED_FRONTIER: Successor receives only a deterministic orthogonal current-binding artifact at the exact handoff plus post-replacement events. No predecessor prose and no pre-handoff raw event ledger. The artifact contains no action recommendation.

primaryEndpoint: exact requiredResponses among valid successor trials

preRegisteredInterpretation.GOVERNED_INHERITANCE_CAPABILITY: GOVERNED_FRONTIER exact-response correctness >=90%, no more safety errors than RESET_EFFECTIVE, >=15 percentage points above RESET_EFFECTIVE, and no worse than RAW_LEDGER by more than 5 percentage points.
preRegisteredInterpretation.EXTERNALIZATION_SUFFICIENCY: GOVERNED_FRONTIER exact-response and consequential-authority correctness are each within 5 percentage points of RAW_LEDGER, while mean total tokens are at least 10% lower than RAW_LEDGER.
preRegisteredInterpretation.GOVERNANCE_OVER_PROSE: GOVERNED_FRONTIER improves exact-response correctness over PREDECESSOR_NOTE by >=15 percentage points or eliminates at least one semantic safety error present in PREDECESSOR_NOTE without introducing a new safety error.
preRegisteredInterpretation.RAW_HISTORY_NEEDED: RAW_LEDGER exceeds GOVERNED_FRONTIER exact-response correctness by >=15 percentage points or has materially fewer semantic safety errors.
preRegisteredInterpretation.NO_INHERITANCE_EFFECT: All four arms are within 5 percentage points on exact responses and no safety separation exists.
preRegisteredInterpretation.MIXED: Any other result. No same-case tuning or automatic extra replicates.

guards: No S1/S2 trial is rescored as S3 evidence.
No S3 full history may exactly copy an S1 or S2 history.
The predecessor note is produced before and without access to the post-replacement shock.
The governed handoff artifact is deterministic from pre-handoff owner truth and contains no requiredResponses or response-catalog strings.
The successor receives no predecessor conversation, hidden state or Harness run context.
Recorded provider/Harness invalids are not retried and are excluded from semantic denominators while still reported.
A positive S3 result supports bounded environmental inheritance; it does not establish open-world institutional legitimacy, emergence, or a new truth owner.
